body_paragraphs: Dear Mr. Murphy,

Please rest assured that we are committed to bringing this matter to a successful conclusion as swiftly as possible. Should you have any questions or require further updates, please do not hesitate to contact me directly.
Thank you for your understanding and patience.
Yours sincerely,
Alex Turner
Legal Associate, Smith & Co. Law

The term "without prejudice" on a letter means that the contents of the letter cannot be used as evidence in any future legal proceedings. It is typically used to encourage open and honest communication during negotiations, such as settlement discussions, without the risk that statements made will prejudice the sender’s position if the matter goes to court.
